title: Mail crate test CIDs use codec 0x55 (raw); production uses 0x71 (DAG-CBOR)
description: mail/state/flags.rs:109: test_cid() creates CIDs with codec 0x55 (raw). Project spec and all other test code (email/types.rs:231) use 0x71 (DAG-CBOR). If production code ever does codec-based dispatch on stored CIDs, 0x55 test CIDs will follow a different code path than real articles. Tests should match production invariants. Fix: change test_cid() to use codec 0x71.
